WITH date_range AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
    dr.d_date,
    SUM(SUM(ws.ws_sales_price)) OVER (
      PARTITION BY ws.ws_item_sk
      ORDER BY dr.d_date
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cume_sales
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_range dr
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, dr.d_date
),
store_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
    dr.d_date,
    SUM(SUM(ss.ss_sales_price)) OVER (
      PARTITION BY ss.ss_item_sk
      ORDER BY dr.d_date
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cume_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_range dr
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, dr.d_date
),
key_set AS (
  SELECT item_sk, d_date FROM web_v1
  UNION
  SELECT item_sk, d_date FROM store_v1
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    k.item_sk,
    k.d_date,
    web.cume_sales AS web_sales,
    store.cume_sales AS store_sales
  FROM key_set k
  LEFT JOIN web_v1 web
    ON web.item_sk = k.item_sk
   AND web.d_date = k.d_date
  LEFT JOIN store_v1 store
    ON store.item_sk = k.item_sk
   AND store.d_date = k.d_date
)
SELECT
  item_sk,
  d_date,
  web_sales,
  store_sales,
  web_cumulative,
  store_cumulative
FROM (
  SELECT
    item_sk,
    d_date,
    web_sales,
    store_sales,
    MAX(web_sales) OVER (
      PARTITION BY item_sk
      ORDER BY d_date
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS web_cumulative,
    MAX(store_sales) OVER (
      PARTITION BY item_sk
      ORDER BY d_date
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS store_cumulative
  FROM combined
) AS y
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
